title: Ops mini-sprint rollup and oddities register
content:
Purpose: lightweight cross-functional register for the 48h ops mini-sprint. Use this to surface oddball items, prioritize quick follow-ups, and capture one-off analyses. Not a replacement for Jira tickets; the goal is quick visibility for cross-team triage.

Top-level summary:
- 9 items logged (3 high impact, 4 medium, 2 low).
- Recurring themes: model-serving tail latency after noon, transient Dedicated pool evictions for a single enterprise tenant, and an embeddings cost outlier linked to an unexpected fallback to high-precision variant.
- Immediate asks: infra to validate eviction triggers (Marcus), product to confirm rollout gating for the console change (Lucia), finance to sanity-check embedding unit chargeback (Ravi).

Follow-ups and recommended owners listed in sheet_rows below. Keep this doc as the canonical rollup for on-call handover until mini-sprint ends.
sheet_rows: ID | Short description | Owner | Impact | Affects | Status | Last note | Follow-up by | Blocker | Quick link

001 | Midday tail latency bump on models/*/v2 at 12:10-12:40 PST | Marcus Chen | High | serving-runtime, observability | investigating | Sampled span: long KV cache miss at 11:58; correlates with cache eviction job | 2029-11-12 | need cache-eviction logs retention beyond 7d | Slack: #runtime-ops thread 11/12

002 | Dedicated pool eviction for acct:AcmeCorp during burst test | Lucia Gomez | High | dedicated, platform-engineering | mitigated (temporary fallback) | Affected requests routed to best-effort pool; customer saw few 503s | 2029-11-13 | confirm autoscaler backoff thresholds | Jira: INFR-5123

003 | Embeddings cost spike for analytics pipeline | Ravi Desai | Medium | hosted-api, billing | triaged | Found path that falls back to non-quantized variant for long seq lengths; cost delta ~3.2x | 2029-11-14 | patch tokenizer pre-split logic; cost calc needed | PR#2241

004 | Console rollout telemetry gap (region eu-west-1) | Product ops (Lucia) | Medium | console-and-rollouts, observability | in_review | Missing route-level traces for 11/9-11/11 due to sampler misconfig | 2029-11-15 | validate retention policy and re-run partial ingest | Confluence note linked

005 | Quick E2E for function-tool calling edge case (empty tool response) | Platform eng | Low | serving-runtime, sdk | needs-test | Unit test added but no e2e; repro steps included | 2029-11-16 | add canary test before next release | GH Issue #987

006 | Minor mismatch in billing labels for reserved capacity commits | Finance | Medium | finance-and-legal | investigating | Some reserved lines missing customer tags, pushes to support | 2029-11-14 | run nightly labeling job across regions | Billing runbook reference

007 | One-off SLO measurement discrepancy between trace and telemetry pipelines | Observability | High | observability, site-reliability-engineering | investigating | Telemetry shows lower p95 by ~8% vs traces for same window | 2029-11-13 | check ingestion timestamps and dedupe logic | Trace sample attached

008 | Customer success asks: template for outage comms during Dedicated incidents | Customer Success | Low | customer-success, product | draft | Template updated, awaiting legal review | 2029-11-18 | legal stamping required | Confluence draft

009 | Temp: quick audit of fallback model variants across regions | Solutions Eng | Medium | serving-runtime, private-deployments | pending | Need matrix of variant compatibilities per region | 2029-11-17 | compile compatibility matrix | Internal spreadsheet link
notes:
Notes to self (Asha): keep rows short; convert any item that requires >2 dev-days into a Jira ticket and link it. For tomorrow's standup, highlight IDs 001, 002, 007. Use this doc to capture ephemeral analysis (e.g., quick CPU profiles, small cost calc) and paste results into the last column.

Unresolved questions:
- Why did the embedding fallback trigger for sequences ~403-512 tokens? (Ravi to validate tokenizer split).
- Are eviction signals coming from internal autoscaler or from underlying cloud provider preemption? (Marcus to correlate metrics with provider maintenance window).

Quick one-off calc pasted below (rough):
- Embedding run sample: 12k tokens across 400 requests -> expected cost $22.6, observed $69.8 -> 3.09x delta (matches reported).

If this doc becomes persistent beyond the mini-sprint, move to product-ops and add structured columns for SLA impact and ticket link.
